title: A Bullet Sits Inside This Crown. Here Is Why. #Shorts
description:
Inside a crown in Portugal, among the gold and the pearls, there is a bullet. It was fired at a pope in 1981.

Two months later, still recovering, he asked for an envelope that had been sealed for thirty-seven years. Two popes before him had opened it, read it, and closed it again without telling anyone.

Full episode: https://youtu.be/WPOzR9rKv2o
